shadows.name: lamplight-glow
shadows.purpose: Softly lifts cards and interactive elements.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #6B1C2A; color: #F5ECD7; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'Literata', serif; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 8px; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(107, 28, 42, 0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(107, 28, 42, 0.4); }

components.name: Base Card
components.description: A warmly lifted container resembling paper.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #F5ECD7; color: #1B2A4A; padding: 24px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Literata', serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(27, 42, 74, 0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(27, 42, 74, 0.05); } .ds-card h3 { font-family: 'Petrona', serif; margin-top: 0; }

narrative.overview: Intimate, grounded, and tactile, evoking a sense of history and warmth. It explicitly rejects the coldness of SaaS and the loudness of gaming dashboards. The design feels like a safe, curated space—an indie bookstore or a literary magazine. It prioritizes feeling, nostalgia, and a handmade physical feel over aggressive metric displays.

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: Deep Midnight Ink is used instead of gray or pure black for all structural borders and text to maintain the warmth of a printed page.

rules.name: The Soft Lamplight Rule
rules.body: Shadows should never feel harsh or industrial; they should emulate the soft, warm glow of lamplight over paper.

dos: Do prioritize a "handmade" or "physical" feel (paper textures, soft shadows).
Do use Deep Midnight Ink instead of gray for depth and text.
Do make the interface feel like entries in a yearbook or an archive.
donts: Don't use cold, pixel-perfect industrial clean-lines.
Don't design aggressive metric displays or harsh competitive rankings.
Don't fall back to modern SaaS aesthetics.
